posts.name: Blume
posts.tagline: AI-ready, Markdown-first documentation framework
posts.description: Ship beautiful, fast, AI-ready documentation from plain markdown. Blume gives you search, theming, SEO, and one-command deploys on Astro and Vite.

posts.name: Expeditione
posts.tagline: The Interactive 3D Encyclopedia
posts.description: Created by a single person, Expeditione is an Interactive 3D Encyclopedia built to make learning fun and memorable. Instead of simply reading about a subject, you can enter handcrafted, explorable worlds and discover them through interaction. It runs directly in the browser, with no login, ads, or tracking, and is optimized to stay remarkably lightweight. The first three expeditions are free forever, with free educator resources for classroom use.

posts.name: HarnessRouter Community Edition
posts.tagline: Open-source unified interface for agent harnesses
posts.description: Plug-and-play managed agent harnesses in your product: Codex, Claude Code and Hermes through one API on your infrastructure, now open sourced under Apache 2.0. Switch harnesses without rebuilding your backend. Sessions, streaming, files, artifacts, cancellation, failure recovery, all handled. Model provider keys, state, and deliveries under your control. Gateway, Runner, Console in one Docker container. Ready-to-use starter kit apps as inspiration of possibilities.

posts.name: Vidaya
posts.tagline: Healthspan score from your wearables, labs, and DNA.
posts.description: Vidaya turns your wearable data, labs, and habits into a real Healthspan score and a personalized longevity plan. Built by founders tired of dashboards that show numbers but never tell you what to actually do next.

posts.name: Chert
posts.tagline: Vapi for FaceTime: AI video agents in a few lines
posts.description: Chert is Vapi for FaceTime. Build and deploy interactive AI video agents that can answer and place FaceTime calls with just a few lines of code. Deploy agents for remote support, field service, telehealth intake, guided onboarding, or anything that's easier to show than explain. Try it live: FaceTime an agent right now and show it something.

posts.name: AirAlarm
posts.tagline: Wake at the end of your sleep cycle
posts.description: AirAlarm turns your iPhone and AirPods into a gentler sleep alarm. Set a wake window, drift off with built-in sounds or your own media, and wake at the end of a 90-minute cycle. No Apple Watch, account, ads, analytics, or cloud sleep profile.

posts.name: CostLogic
posts.tagline: AI-powered construction takeoffs, estimates, and invoices
posts.description: CostLogic is a construction takeoff and job-costing workspace with a powerful agent called Onyx. Onyx can perform actions on your behalf. Upload plans, detect rooms, calibrate scale, measure quantities, turn takeoffs into estimates, and send invoices, all in one browser-based workflow. Go from blueprint to invoice without stitching together five different tools, and turn days into hours or minutes of work.

posts.name: Vaaya
posts.tagline: Turn your Github profile into Credit Card for your agents
posts.description: Build your agentic credit score from your github profile credit profile and give your agents money to spend. Enable your agents to access 1400+ tools like Exa, Firecrawl, Fal (media generation), Apollo.io, Browserbase, Modal and a lot more with just one MCP. Installing Vaaya is simple just run npx @vaaya/mcp install

posts.name: Open Analytics
posts.tagline: AI-native Google Analytics alternative for the modern web
posts.description: Open Analytics is an open-source, privacy-first alternative to Google Analytics, built for humans and AI agents. Track real-time visitors, funnels, and revenue with one lightweight, cookieless script. Connect your analytics to AI tools via MCP. GDPR-friendly with no consent banner, and self-hostable.

posts.name: Assetli.app
posts.tagline: Personal finance & net worth, wired to your AI
posts.description: Most finance apps just show you a dashboard. Assetli lets your AI use it. Connect directly to Claude or ChatGPT via MCP — your assistant reads your real net worth, transactions and portfolio, and can update them too, right inside your own AI chat (we never see it). Beyond budgeting, Assetli tracks stocks, crypto, real estate, vehicles and valuables in one place, with built-in FIRE, mortgage and rent-vs-buy calculators. No forced bank linking — import via CSV/PDF, stay in control.

posts.name: Scaloom
posts.tagline: AI-powered Reddit marketing for Google & AI search
posts.description: Scaloom is an AI-powered Reddit marketing platform that helps founders build trusted accounts and turn Reddit into a search acquisition channel. ✅ Warm up Reddit accounts for karma & trust ✅ Find relevant subreddits and conversations ✅ Draft AI replies with human approval ✅ Find Reddit threads already ranking on Google ✅ Track brand visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude & Perplexity ✅ Discover GEO/SEO content opportunities

posts.name: Interview Agent by NexI
posts.tagline: AI interviews that screen, score, and shortlist talent
posts.description: Transform your hiring process with Interview Agent by NexI. AI-powered automated interviews, intelligent candidate evaluation, and seamless recruitment workflow. Powered by TalentArbor technology.

posts.name: ShouldBuild
posts.tagline: Find out what your market wants before you waste months
posts.description: You can build for months before finding out nobody wanted it. ShouldBuild reads what real users already complain about — across the app stores, Reddit, Hacker News and the open web — and hands you a build / don't-build verdict backed by quotes you can click. Keep the findings worth keeping, turn them into a concept and a backlog, and every Monday see what moved: new rivals, new complaints, and whether what you shipped made its complaint go down. 7-day free trial, no card needed.

posts.name: Yap - Voice Diary
posts.tagline: Journaling Made Easy
posts.description: Journal without typing. Open the app and yap about your day. It's that simple. The app tidies it up and keeps track of your mood, habits, to-dos and the small things you mention about your friends and family. Each day is also summarised, making going back in time easy. Memos, transcripts, notes all local on your device. Export at any time.

posts.name: Asakiri Studio
posts.tagline: Local first language course creation platform
posts.description: Asakiri Studio is a completely free, open source tool to make language courses which has the depth of textbooks with exercises like language apps.

posts.name: GetAppNiche
posts.tagline: 💰 Stop building apps nobody wants. See what any app earns
posts.description: Most app ideas die in the dark: months of building, zero validation. GetAppNiche turns the lights on: 💰 Revenue & download estimates for 3.6M+ apps, App Store + Google Play 🔍 Explore both stores like a database: growth, price model, category filters 🎯 ASO keywords with difficulty scores, daily rank tracking 🕵️ Competitors' ads, creators and review complaints 🔌 API + MCP: ask Claude or Cursor to find niches for you

posts.name: Whimscope App
posts.tagline: Micro-adventure ideas for your everyday life
posts.description: Whimscope gives you simple micro-adventure ideas for everyday life — matched to your time, energy, mood and budget. Look through the lens for an idea, save it, plan it solo or with friends, and keep the moment in your Journal once it's done. Most apps in this space help you organise what you already planned. Whimscope helps you want something in the first place. It's not a habit tracker and it won't nag you. Now out of beta, on the App Store and Google Play.

posts.name: PixelGlass
posts.tagline: Make your Ghost Publication stand out from the crowd.
posts.description: PixelGlass turns your idea into a real, custom Ghost theme - AI Customized, no code required. Design your blog, newsletter, or publication, fast.

posts.name: Fabbit
posts.tagline: All your growth data. One next move.
posts.description: Fabbit is a unified growth intelligence platform (SEO, analytics, competitors, CRM, site audit, all in one hub) that turns scattered data into a daily actionable next step. Its core differentiator: most tools "show data," Fabbit "shows data and tells you what to do about it," fast.

posts.name: Nadhi Audit
posts.tagline: Airgapped AI security auditor & verified code fixes
posts.description: Nadhi Audit is the first 100% air-gapped AI security code auditor and AST auto-remediator for macOS. Powered on-device by Apple Silicon Metal GPU, 0 bytes of proprietary source code or secrets ever leave your machine. Scan for OWASP Top 10, CWE, DPDP, HIPAA, and GDPR issues in milliseconds. Nadhi does not just alert; it kinda patches code, passes compiler syntax gates, verifies via a local LLM judge, and opens signed GitHub PRs. Includes built-in MCP server support for Claude Code and Cursor.

posts.name: Page to Markdown
posts.tagline: Clean Markdown from any webpage, right beside it.
posts.description: Page to Markdown is a local-first Chrome side panel that turns the page you’re reading, or just the passage you select, into clean Markdown. Choose Clean page, Full page, or Selection; keep the links, tables, and code blocks you need; then copy it or download anmd file. Built for research, notes, documentation, AI workflows, and your trusty AI slop boys. No account. No remote processing. Just markdown baby!

posts.name: Vessa
posts.tagline: The only brand guidelines that move
posts.description: Vessa turns your brand guidelines into a live web page. Colors copy to the clipboard when you click them, type specimens render in the real fonts, and every section is choreographed with motion your client can feel instead of reading about. Each guideline ships a brand.json and an MCP server, so your AI tools can read and write the brand. You buy a brand once and it stays yours, with nothing to renew.

posts.name: Subscrr
posts.tagline: All your subscriptions. And what they really cost.
posts.description: Subscrr keeps every recurring payment in one place and shows what it really costs per day, month and year. Point the camera at a receipt and AI sorts it into categories - no bank connection needed. iPhone and Apple Watch.

posts.name: BentoTerm
posts.tagline: The terminal for watching and talking to your AI agents
posts.description: Run your agents in parallel, direct them by voice, and pick the work up from anywhere. Each habit makes the others stronger, together they multiply how much you get done. Under the hood it's a native app, speaking real tmux control mode. One session follows you across Mac, iPhone and iPad; your agents run on macOS, Linux or WSL. No account required. Voice works out of the box, or bring your own API key. Free & open source.

posts.name: KeyGenerator.io
posts.tagline: Password, JWT secret and AES key generator, fully offline
posts.description: Generates passwords, JWT signing secrets and AES keys with crypto.getRandomValues. CSS, JS and translations are inlined at build time, so once the page loads it makes no network requests at all. Open the Network tab and watch it stay empty. 7 languages.

posts.name: AlsonAI Poetry
posts.tagline: Turn poetry and spoken word into illustrated books.
posts.description: AlsonAI now supports poetry, spoken word, rhymes, and writing that doesn’t fit a traditional story arc. Instead of forcing every idea into a narrative, AlsonAI learns when not to write—respecting line breaks, repetition, pacing, and the creator’s voice while helping turn their words into a polished illustrated book. It’s a creative assistant built to add value without getting in the way.

posts.name: Harbor ATS/CRM
posts.tagline: The only ATS/CRM built by actual recruiters.
posts.description: We are active recruiters and run a small recruiting agency (https://workinbiotech.com/recruit). We built Harbor ATS/CRM as an internal tool and battle-tested it for a few years. We were not happy with existing legacy software that is bloated, overpriced, and designed for large corporate teams—not independent recruiters or small recruiting agencies.

posts.name: NullOrigin
posts.tagline: Strip AI watermarks and C2PA metadata with a local proxy.
posts.description: NullOrigin is an open-source local proxy that intercepts and neutralizes AI watermarks and provenance metadata in transit. Simply point your OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini SDKs to localhost. NullOrigin pipes streaming text through a local SLM (via Ollama) to mathematically destroy statistical watermarks like KGW on the fly. It also strips C2PA/EXIF metadata from images and scans generated code for Trojan Source vulnerabilities. Built for researchers and privacy-focused developers.

posts.name: OwnPay
posts.tagline: Self-hosted, open-source payment gateway software
posts.description: OwnPay is an open-source organization building self-hosted payment infrastructure giving developers, merchants, and businesses complete ownership of their financial stack. We pioneered the world's first self-hosted white-label custom-domain checkout architecture: one server, multiple brands, each on its own domain, logo, and color scheme customers see your brand, never OwnPay.

posts.name: crosswalk mcp
posts.tagline: like reddit in claude code
posts.description: crosswalk is a social mcp where you chat with friends or build communities in Claude (or other agents): shared context stores a group's agents read and write, pulled just when you need it.

posts.name: Factualizer
posts.tagline: Remove propaganda from news articles and keep only the facts
posts.description: Factualizer rewrites the news 📰 you're already reading — minus the propaganda. Our Chrome extension uses AI (Claude, GPT, or built-in models) to detect bias, propaganda, and unverified claims in any article, then rewrites it from a neutral point of view. It researches the topic in real time via web search, adds inline commentary where context is missing, and scores every article's reliability using academically 🎓 devised rubrics. Read the story, not the agenda.

posts.name: Burnout Sentinel
posts.tagline: Warning system burnout use workload and recovery indicators.
posts.description: Burnout Sentinel is an early warning system designed specifically for students to detect academic overload and proactively rebalance their weekly commitments before stress transforms into chronic burnout. Moving beyond conventional, reactive to-do lists that merely track completion tasks, Burnout Sentinel acts as an active, preventative wellness advisor. By evaluating the delicate interplay between academic/professional obligations and essential recovery metrics.

posts.name: Backstory
posts.tagline: "3 years ago today" — remember the days that changed you
posts.description: Backstory saves the days that shaped you — wins, losses, firsts, goodbyes — with the story, photos, even a voice memo. Every year on the anniversary it quietly brings each one back: "3 years ago today." Unlike streak-driven journals, it's built to cherish, not nag. A "remember gently" mode softens anniversaries of loss — no confetti, no streaks. Local-first and private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Free, in 4 languages.

posts.name: Fottory
posts.tagline: Check your dating photos free, then generate better ones
posts.description: Check the dating photos you already have, free and without an account. Then make new ones from your own selfies, for Tinder, Hinge and Bumble.

posts.name: Intervu
posts.tagline: Search 2M+ live jobs from inside Claude
posts.description: Intervu pulls jobs straight from company career pages — over 2M live roles, screened for ghost-job risk and repost age. Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Cursor to search, save and track applications in chat. Every employer gets a page: roles opened vs closed over 90 days.

posts.name: Agentinel
posts.tagline: The local security guardrail for AI coding agents
posts.description: Because your AI loves slopsquatting. The zero-cost, locally-run firewall for AI agents. Designed to instantly intercept hallucinated and malicious packages across JavaScript, Python, and Rust before your terminal runs them.

posts.name: AgentOS
posts.tagline: Rust runtime for AI agents with time-travel replay
posts.description: AgentOS is a Rust runtime layer that sits underneath agent frameworks instead of replacing them. One command gives you a supervised agent process, a health endpoint, a gRPC message bus, a live SSE event stream and a journaled trace. Every LLM exchange and tool result is recorded at the provider boundary, so any run replays deterministically with no API cost. Open source, local-first, currently alpha.

posts.name: Dike
posts.tagline: Arabic legal sources, built for AI agents
posts.description: Verifiable Arabic legal sources across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Egypt, through one bilingual API built for AI agents that cite real law, not guesses.

posts.name: Simple Calendar Sync
posts.tagline: Sync and merge your calendars locally. Private, offline.
posts.description: Simple app to sync and combine your calendars locally on your device without sending your data to external servers or tracking software. Merge events from Google Calendar, Outlook or any calendar account on your device into a single calendar: block time across accounts, avoid double bookings and keep your real availability up to date everywhere. All the synchronization happens 100% on your device.

posts.name: Orkestrai
posts.tagline: Orchestrate a team of AI coding agents on a canvas
posts.description: Open-source desktop app to run a team of AI coding agents on a visual canvas. A leader delegates, specialists build, each in its own real terminal. Multi-provider (Claude, Codex, Kimi and more), a coordination bridge, Council, Automations, voice, remote colaboration, remote terminal. macOS, Windows, Linux.

posts.name: CXRompix: Free Bulk Image Downloader
posts.tagline: How to save images from any website:safely extract HD photos
posts.description: CXRompix is a bulletproof bulk image downloader engineered for e-commerce, design, and web scraping. Built on a robust local DOM parser, it bypasses disabled right-clicks and extracts hidden CSS/HTML5 media seamlessly. Features include an infinite auto-scroll engine, native WebP to PNG conversion, and a Magic Cursor for 1-click instant saves. 100% private with no cloud tracking. Perfect for archiving visual boards, scraping product catalogs, and streamlining your digital workflow.

posts.name: Intervu
posts.tagline: Search 2M+ live jobs from inside Claude
posts.description: Intervu pulls jobs straight from company career pages — over 2M live roles, screened for ghost-job risk and repost age. posts.tagline: Create a storyboard and contact sheet from any video
posts.description: Cutsio Storyboard turns your video into a timestamped visual overview in seconds. Choose 9, 16, or 25 frames, generate a clean JPEG storyboard, and scan your footage at a glance. Everything runs in your browser, and your video stays on your device.

posts.name: TikFuel Social
posts.tagline: AI TikTok Script Generator
posts.description: TikFuel Social turns a rough idea into a complete, shot-by-shot TikTok script built for attention. Choose your goal, angle and hook, then get the spoken script, on-screen text, visual direction, caption, hashtags, CTA and retention notes. Built on what we’ve learned since 2020 from 800,000+ short-form videos. Try 10 full scripts every month for free: no credit card, no expiring trial. We’re keeping the free plan generous to learn from your feedback and keep improving the generator

posts.name: SentryDock
posts.tagline: Real-time alerts on the news that moves markets
posts.description: Monitor public local news, official sites and supported social sources. Use AI filtering, translation and source-linked alerts to follow market events.

posts.name: Menory - Your menu memory
posts.tagline: Remember what you ordered
posts.description: Snap a receipt and Menory remembers what you ordered, so you never forget that great dish next time you're back.

posts.name: Nthly - 2FA Authenticator
posts.tagline: Nthly is a private and secure authenticator.
posts.description: Nthly is a private, secure authenticator that generates one-time passwords using the TOTP and HOTP standards. Sign in to Google, GitHub, your bank, work accounts, and hundreds of other services. There are no accounts to create and no third-party servers to trust. Your secrets stay on your iPhone.

posts.name: Quick Voice Quote
posts.tagline: Create construction quotes in seconds  - just speak.
posts.description: A mobile app for construction professionals that lets you create quotes simply by speaking. You describe the work verbally → the quote is generated → you send it to the client. Compatible with iPhone and Android.

posts.name: screenshot-time-machine
posts.tagline: A Wayback Machine for your site. Screenshot every page.
posts.description: Like a Wayback Machine for your own website. One command screenshots every page of your local site into a dated folder, building a visual history you can scroll back through. From the second run on, it shows which pages came out different since last time, so you know exactly where to look instead of clicking through all of them. Full-page PNGs, plain files on your own machine. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex so your agent can check what it built. Free, MIT, 100% local, No account.

posts.name: KalosMedia
posts.tagline: Upload once. Publish everywhere, natively.
posts.description: Most schedulers never actually publish — they open a share sheet or automate a browser and hope. KalosMedia publishes for real, through each platform's own API, to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, and YouTube from one upload. A real video vault instead of scattered folders, a visual scheduling calendar, and best-time-to-post insights built from your own publish history — not generic benchmarks. AI editing (auto-captions, auto-reframe, silence removal, auto-clip) is landing shortly after launch.

posts.name: Peer
posts.tagline: 1:1 video calls & screen share in-browser. No account.
posts.description: Peer is the fastest way to get on a video call with screen sharing: click once, send the link, talk. No sign-up, no download, no app — on either side. 1:1 rooms. Camera, mic, and screen are separate toggles. Media travels peer-to-peer over WebRTC. Rooms expire after 12 hours — no history, no recordings. Optional password. Any modern browser, desktop and mobile. Free. For when "let me see your screen" shouldn't need an account: family tech help, code reviews, showing a design to a client.

posts.name: Sena Slowblog
posts.tagline: a calm place to write
posts.description: Sena Slowblog is a writing platform for people who want to write without the pressure of constantly publishing, promoting, and competing for attention. Unlike traditional blogging platforms, Sena intentionally limits publishing: Free members can publish once every six days, while Sena Circle members can publish once every three days. The limitation is not a restriction. It is part of the product. We're exploring what happens when a publishing platform asks you to slow down instead.

posts.name: VoicePen AI
posts.tagline: Fastest way to write, think, and capture ideas on the web
posts.description: A voice-powered dictation assistant and context-aware AI notebook that lives wherever you browse.

posts.name: The Project Valentine
posts.tagline: Find love beyond the swipe: No ghosting, just real dates.
posts.description: The Project Valentine is an AI-powered serious relationship app built to end dating app burnout. Instead of photo swiping, you match 1-on-1 through deep guided AI journaling. Featuring zero public profiles, mandatory date feedback to eliminate ghosting, and video calls before meeting in real life.

posts.name: TinyComp
posts.tagline: No.1 Batch Media Compressor for images & videos! 100% Local
posts.description: Shrink hundreds of photos & videos locally in seconds with TinyComp! 👋Stop fighting "file too large" errors and bloated cloud utilities. TinyComp is a lightning-fast batch media compressor that shrinks PNG, JPEG, AVIF, WebP, HEIC, MP4, and MOV files by up to 90% without visible quality loss.Massive Batching: Drop 100+ files at once.100% Local Privacy: Files never leave your device. Works offline.Real-Time Preview: Dial in the perfect size vs. quality balance.

posts.name: heere - Stories Underfoot
posts.tagline: history,story,map,travel,tour,explore,guide,citywalk,trip
posts.description: The idea started pretty simply. I kept feeling that with AI now in the picture, there should be a more interesting way to travel and learn the history of any given place. So I built heere, an app that automatically tells you the history of wherever you're standing, based on your real time location. As an indie developer, this kind of product, one that makes everyday life feel just a little different, is exactly what I want to be making.

posts.name: Flocal
posts.tagline: Plan better. Focus more. Achieve every day.
posts.description: Flocal combines the Getting Things Done methodology and the Pomodoro Technique in one place. Capture everything, organize, prioritize your tasks, and focus on what matters with built-in focus timers. The heavy lifting of breaking down main tasks into smaller tasks is done by AI. The weekly reflections and planning is done by AI. Make AI chat assistant your companion to do all the heavy lifting for you.

posts.name: Flocal
posts.tagline: Plan better. Focus more. Achieve every day.
posts.description: Flocal combines the Getting Things Done methodology and the Pomodoro Technique in one place. The weekly reflections and planning is done by AI. Make AI chat assistant your companion to do all the heavy lifting for you.

posts.name: Novelens.ai
posts.tagline: Finish the books you've always meant to read
posts.description: Most AI book tools just summarize and call it a day. Novelens.ai helps you actually finish, not skip. Every classic gets a faithful, warm abridgment that keeps the author's voice and plot intact — a door in, not a substitute. A living character map tracks who's who, so a name from 300 pages back won't stop you cold. A reading companion answers questions mid-chapter, without losing your place. Start with any public-domain classic in the library, or upload your own book and customize it.

posts.name: Draftera
posts.tagline: Your personal and business documents, finally organized
posts.description: Draftera is a private workspace for your personal and business documents. Create, scan, organize, sign and securely share files while keeping both spaces completely separate. Build investor data rooms, create documents with AI, set reminders and keep important records like passports, leases, insurance, NDAs and company files organized and ready when you need them. Early access is free.

posts.name: ksol
posts.tagline: pick your energy, press play
posts.description: The average person in India listens to ~8 hrs of music a month; only around 5 songs a day. Not because we don't love music enough, but because finding something to play became a hassle, and algorithms just feed us what we already know. KSOL is an attempt to solve that: pick a channel that fits your mood, press play, and discover songs chosen by humans, not algorithms. Always on, ad-free, and you can save what you love. 8 streams are live now, more coming soon.

posts.name: Take a  breather. You are doing enough.
posts.tagline: Productivity,Health and Fitness, Mental Health, WebApp
posts.description: A soothing 1-minute visual experience designed to help overwhelmed women release inner pressure, pause, and rest. You are doing enough, and you deserve a moment of peace.

posts.name: Useful Tools Zone
posts.tagline: 100% private, serverless client-side web utilities
posts.description: Useful Tools Zone is a suite of 100% private, serverless web utilities powered by WebAssembly. Compress & split videos, merge PDFs, and optimize media directly in your browser with zero cloud uploads. 🔒 100% Local Privacy (Zero cloud uploads) ⚡ Zero Server Latency & 1-Click Direct Exports ✈️ True Offline Browser Sandbox 🎯 Creator Presets for WhatsApp, Reels & Socials

posts.name: Fwdpage
posts.tagline: More than a link in bio. Calmer than social media.
posts.description: A privacy-first profile page to share links, posts, videos, music, events and more — all in one place, without tracking. No cookies. No third-party requests — no CDN, no Google Fonts, no analytics service. Open DevTools and check. Login runs on a magic link or a passkey. Chronological feed, no algorithm, no ads. Servers in Germany. Free to use.

posts.name: domain2social
posts.tagline: Check a name across social + domains — honest answers
posts.description: Check a brand name across social platforms and domain extensions in one real-time scan. A free Chrome extension — available, taken, or honestly unknown, never a guess.

posts.name: Paperditor – free Markdown editor
posts.tagline: A clean Markdown editor that renders as you type
posts.description: A clean, distraction-free Markdown editor. Contribute to guisaldanha/paperditor development by creating an account on GitHub.

posts.name: wagecheck
posts.tagline: Free UK salary, tax and stamp duty calculators.
posts.description: Wagecheck is a free online toolkit for calculating UK salary, income tax, and stamp duty. Whether you're checking your take-home pay, working out how much tax you'll owe, or estimating stamp duty on a property purchase, Wagecheck gives you fast, accurate results with a simple, no-clutter interface.

posts.name: Velvet: Get the Date
posts.tagline: Get the Date, not another endless chat.
posts.description: Velvet is your AI dating wingman that helps you turn matches into meaningful conversations. Upload a chat screenshot and get personalized replies that match your style whether you want to be funny, confident, flirty, or genuine. Stop overthinking every message and start having conversations that lead to real dates. Join the waitlist and be among the first to experience smarter dating with AI.

posts.name: Temponia
posts.tagline: Time tracking your AI assistant can use too
posts.description: Time tracking with a native MCP server: connect Temponia to Claude or ChatGPT and log hours, query your week, and build reports in plain language. Underneath: calendar-based timesheets, Jira sync, and invoicing via Xero or QuickBooks.

posts.tagline: Error tracking and observability built for Ruby on Rails

Monitor errors, performance, database queries, background jobs, HTTP requests, cache activity and deployments from one place. Get the context behind production issues instead of digging through scattered logs. Install the chronos-ruby gem, connect your app and start monitoring in minutes — with a clean experience designed specifically for Rails developers.

posts.name: Sshly — SSH, made friendly.
posts.tagline: SSH, SFTP & tunnels for Mac — with safe AI access
posts.description: A friendly SSH client for Mac. Connections, keys, files — all in one app. No subscriptions. No bloat.

posts.name: RelicBeam
